refusal.CLOUD_SETTINGS_ACCESS_DENIED: This account is not yet authorized to use cloud Cindy. Ask an administrator to enable it.
refusal.CLOUD_SETTINGS_MEMBER_SUSPENDED: Cloud Cindy is suspended for your account, or its authorization has expired. Your data is kept. Ask an administrator.
refusal.CLOUD_SETTINGS_ADMISSION_CLOSED: Your organization is not giving out cloud Cindy right now. Ask an administrator.
refusal.CLOUD_SETTINGS_ADMISSION_NOT_LISTED: Your account has not been admitted to cloud Cindy yet. Ask an administrator to add you.
refusal.CLOUD_SETTINGS_ADMISSION_FULL: Your organization has reached its cloud Cindy limit. Ask an administrator.
refusal.CLOUD_SETTINGS_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You have reached your cloud Cindy limit. Ask an administrator to raise it.
refusal.CLOUD_SETTINGS_INSTANCE_TRANSFERRED: This cloud Cindy has been transferred to someone else and can no longer be woken. Ask an administrator if you still need it.
refusal.CLOUD_SETTINGS_TRANSFER_IN_PROGRESS: Transferred files are being copied. It is available again in a few minutes.
